newsitem.title: UK: NWE heating oil premiums slip on rising supply.
newsitem.headline: NWE heating oil premiums slip on rising supply.

text.p: NWE gas oil futures eased in line with IPE futures on Tuesday and premiums for heating oil softened on perceptions of increased supplies, traders said.
Nov IPE futures ended down $3.25 at 230.25 a tonne.
Two cargoes of German heating oil sold at Nov IPE +$7 into Rostock and Bremen, $3 weaker than Monday.
A Russian cargo was sold into Germany at Nov IPE +$5.50 cif Hamburg for the second half Oct, around $4 lower than Monday, but more than $1 above the cargo sold earlier in the day.
"There's enough heating oil around," one trader said.
But diesel premiums remained firm on tight supply.
Traders valued diesel in a range Nov IPE +$35/38 cif NWE, but prices depended very much on timing and other factors.
On the barge market, one trader said his best offer for low sulphur diesel (-3/-13) was Nov IPE +$33 fob ARA, with buying interest a dollar lower.
Heating oil barges traded at Nov IPE +$5 and +$6 fob ARA, around $2 lower than Monday.
